C08-M02-L03-F1.title: One domain sign-in, three machines, five events
C08-M02-L03-F1.caption: A Kerberos sign-in at WS-101 followed by a share access on FS01, showing which machine writes which Security event at each step.
C08-M02-L03-F1.alt: Sequence diagram with four lanes: Asha (user), WS-101 (workstation), DC01 (domain controller, KDC: AS + TGS) and FS01 (file server, SMB share). Asha enters user name and password at WS-101. WS-101 sends AS-REQ with pre-auth to DC01; DC01 replies AS-REP with a TGT and logs 4768. WS-101 sends TGS-REQ for host/WS-101; DC01 replies with a service ticket and logs 4769. WS-101 creates the session and logs 4624 type 2. Later WS-101 sends TGS-REQ for cifs/FS01; DC01 replies with a service ticket and logs 4769. WS-101 sends AP-REQ to FS01 to open the share; FS01 logs 4624 type 3.
C08-M02-L03-F1.note: The DC records ticket requests; each target records the session and its logon type. Collect both.

C08-M02-L03-F2.title: A password spray on the Banyan VPN, 06:41:30 to 06:47:00 UTC
C08-M02-L03-F2.caption: A five-and-a-half-minute window of VPN events from the Banyan dataset: eight single failures across eight users from one address, then one success as gopal.
C08-M02-L03-F2.alt: Timeline diagram from 06:41:30 to 06:47:00 UTC with three rows. Row one, VPN failures from 203.0.113.66, has eight ticks close together in the first quarter of the window, labelled 8 users, one try each, 7 s apart. Row two, gopal, has a tick inside that cluster for a failure at 06:42:42 and a tick far to the right for a success at 06:46:00. Row three, divya, has one tick inside the cluster for a failure at 06:42:21 while she was logged on at WS-104 since 03:18.
